# Studio, admin and relay API

These endpoints are for the studio, not for agents. Agents use the MCP endpoint (`/mcp`)
with an OAuth bearer token. Everything under `/v1/studio` is signed with the same
HMAC-SHA256 scheme the gateway uses toward the backend (see docs/PROTOCOL.md). The signed
`X-AG-Player` header is the player (or, for admin calls, the acting admin). Every response to
a signed call carries `Cache-Control: no-store`.

The same API as an OpenAPI 3.1 file: [studio.yaml](../openapi/studio.yaml). This page is generated from it.

## Signing

**`studioSignature`.** HMAC-SHA256 request signing with the studio key. The five headers `X-AG-Key-Id`, `X-AG-Timestamp`, `X-AG-Player`, `X-AG-Idempotency-Key` and `X-AG-Signature` are all required. The signed string and the verifier rules are in docs/PROTOCOL.md. The timestamp must be within 5 minutes, and each (key id, idempotency key) pair is accepted once. Go callers can use `pkg/agentsig`.

**`adminSignature`.** The same scheme, signed with the admin key (`--admin-key-id`, secret `AGENTGW_ADMIN_SECRET`), which must differ from the studio key. `X-AG-Player` names the acting admin.

Headers on every signed call:

| Header | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `X-AG-Key-Id` | Which shared secret signed the request (supports rotation). |
| `X-AG-Timestamp` | Unix seconds when the request was signed. |
| `X-AG-Player` | The player the call is for. For admin calls, the acting admin. |
| `X-AG-Idempotency-Key` | Unique per request. A repeated pair of key id and idempotency key is refused as a replay. |
| `X-AG-Signature` | Lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 of the signed string. |

## Link tickets and grants

Let a player link an agent, and let the game show and revoke linked agents. Signed with the studio key.

### `POST /v1/studio/link-tickets`

**Mint a link ticket for a player.** The game shows the returned code to a logged in player. The player types it on the consent page to link an agent. A ticket is single use and valid for 5 minutes. The signed `X-AG-Player` is the player the ticket belongs to.

Auth: `studioSignature`.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | The ticket. | `Ticket` |
| `401` | The signature is missing, wrong, stale, or the signed request was already used. | `Error`, error `invalid_client` |
| `413` | The body is over the endpoint's limit. | `Error`, error `too_large` |
| `503` | A store failed or the replay cache is full. Nothing changed. Retry with a new idempotency key. | `Error`, error `temporarily_unavailable` |

Example response:

```json
{
  "ticket": "K7QF-9M2X",
  "expires_at": "2026-01-02T03:09:05Z"
}
```

### `GET /v1/studio/grants`

**List the player's linked agents.** Lists the player's active grants, oldest first. `client_name` is empty if the client is gone.

Auth: `studioSignature`.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | The grants. | object |
| `401` | The signature is missing, wrong, stale, or the signed request was already used. | `Error`, error `invalid_client` |
| `503` | A store failed or the replay cache is full. Nothing changed. Retry with a new idempotency key. | `Error`, error `temporarily_unavailable` |

Example response:

```json
{
  "grants": [
    {
      "id": "9f2c0a",
      "client_id": "c1",
      "client_name": "Claude on the laptop",
      "scope": "operator",
      "resource": "https://gw.example/mcp",
      "created_at": "2026-01-02T03:04:05Z"
    }
  ]
}
```

### `DELETE /v1/studio/grants`

**Revoke all of the player's grants.** A "log out all agents" button. Repeating it returns `{"revoked":0}`.

Auth: `studioSignature`.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | How many grants were revoked. | object |
| `401` | The signature is missing, wrong, stale, or the signed request was already used. | `Error`, error `invalid_client` |
| `503` | A store failed or the replay cache is full. Nothing changed. Retry with a new idempotency key. | `Error`, error `temporarily_unavailable` |

Example response:

```json
{
  "revoked": 2
}
```

### `DELETE /v1/studio/grants/{id}`

**Revoke one grant.** Revokes the grant and every token of it, effective on the next token lookup. A grant that does not exist, is already revoked or belongs to another player gives the same `404`, so ids cannot be probed.

Auth: `studioSignature`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string | yes | The grant id from the list. |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `204` | Revoked. |  |
| `401` | The signature is missing, wrong, stale, or the signed request was already used. | `Error`, error `invalid_client` |
| `404` | Does not exist, expired, or belongs to someone else. The three look the same so ids cannot be probed. | `Error`, error `not_found` |
| `503` | A store failed or the replay cache is full. Nothing changed. Retry with a new idempotency key. | `Error`, error `temporarily_unavailable` |

## Confirmations

The player approves or denies a pending action in the game's own UI. Signed with the studio key.

### `GET /v1/studio/confirmations`

**List the player's pending confirmations.** Live pending confirmations, oldest first. The list is empty when there are none.

Auth: `studioSignature`.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | The confirmations. | object |
| `401` | The signature is missing, wrong, stale, or the signed request was already used. | `Error`, error `invalid_client` |
| `503` | A store failed or the replay cache is full. Nothing changed. Retry with a new idempotency key. | `Error`, error `temporarily_unavailable` |

Example response:

```json
{
  "confirmations": [
    {
      "id": "3f1a77",
      "tool": "build_structure",
      "state": "pending",
      "created_at": "2026-01-02T03:04:05Z",
      "expires_at": "2026-01-02T03:14:05Z",
      "args_sha256": "9b7e00"
    }
  ]
}
```

### `POST /v1/studio/confirmations/{id}/approve`

**Approve a pending confirmation.** Idempotent: approving an approved confirmation is also `204`. The approval stays bound to one exact tool call and expires with the confirmation (10 minutes). A confirmation that does not exist, has expired or belongs to another player gives `404`.

Auth: `studioSignature`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string | yes | The confirmation id. |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `204` | Approved. |  |
| `401` | The signature is missing, wrong, stale, or the signed request was already used. | `Error`, error `invalid_client` |
| `404` | Does not exist, expired, or belongs to someone else. The three look the same so ids cannot be probed. | `Error`, error `not_found` |
| `409` | The confirmation cannot make that move, for example approving a denied one. | `Error`, error `wrong_state` |
| `503` | A store failed or the replay cache is full. Nothing changed. Retry with a new idempotency key. | `Error`, error `temporarily_unavailable` |

### `POST /v1/studio/confirmations/{id}/deny`

**Deny a pending confirmation.** Idempotent: denying a denied confirmation is also `204`.

Auth: `studioSignature`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string | yes | The confirmation id. |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `204` | Denied. |  |
| `401` | The signature is missing, wrong, stale, or the signed request was already used. | `Error`, error `invalid_client` |
| `404` | Does not exist, expired, or belongs to someone else. The three look the same so ids cannot be probed. | `Error`, error `not_found` |
| `409` | The confirmation cannot make that move, for example approving a denied one. | `Error`, error `wrong_state` |
| `503` | A store failed or the replay cache is full. Nothing changed. Retry with a new idempotency key. | `Error`, error `temporarily_unavailable` |

## Manifest

Upload, read and roll back the tool manifest. Signed with the admin key.

### `PUT /v1/studio/manifest`

**Upload and activate a manifest.** Validates the body, stores it as a new version, activates it and serves it from the next request on. An invalid manifest changes nothing. Other replicas pick the new version up within `--manifest-poll`. `X-AG-Player` names the acting admin and is recorded as the version's `actor`. Not mounted unless an admin key is configured.

Auth: `adminSignature`.

Request body (`application/json`, `application/yaml`): The manifest, at most 1 MiB. JSON, or YAML with `Content-Type` of `application/yaml`.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | The new, active version. | `ManifestVersion` |
| `401` | The signature is missing, wrong, stale, or the signed request was already used. | `Error`, error `invalid_client` |
| `413` | The body is over the endpoint's limit. | `Error`, error `too_large` |
| `422` | The manifest failed validation. Nothing changed. | `Error`, error `invalid_manifest` |
| `503` | A store failed or the replay cache is full. Nothing changed. Retry with a new idempotency key. | `Error`, error `temporarily_unavailable` |

Example response:

```json
{
  "id": 3,
  "sha256": "ab12cd",
  "actor": "ci",
  "created_at": "2026-01-02T03:04:05Z",
  "tools": 12,
  "active": true
}
```

### `GET /v1/studio/manifest`

**Read the active manifest.**

Auth: `adminSignature`.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | The active version and its manifest. | object |
| `401` | The signature is missing, wrong, stale, or the signed request was already used. | `Error`, error `invalid_client` |
| `404` | Does not exist, expired, or belongs to someone else. The three look the same so ids cannot be probed. | `Error`, error `not_found` |
| `503` | A store failed or the replay cache is full. Nothing changed. Retry with a new idempotency key. | `Error`, error `temporarily_unavailable` |

### `GET /v1/studio/manifest/versions`

**List manifest versions.** All versions, newest first. Exactly one has `active` set.

Auth: `adminSignature`.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | The versions. | object |
| `401` | The signature is missing, wrong, stale, or the signed request was already used. | `Error`, error `invalid_client` |
| `503` | A store failed or the replay cache is full. Nothing changed. Retry with a new idempotency key. | `Error`, error `temporarily_unavailable` |

### `POST /v1/studio/manifest/versions/{id}/activate`

**Roll back (or forward) to a version.** Makes an existing version active again. The stored document is validated again with the current rules. If it no longer passes the answer is `422` and nothing changes.

Auth: `adminSignature`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | integer (int64) | yes | The version id. |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | The version, now active. | `ManifestVersion` |
| `401` | The signature is missing, wrong, stale, or the signed request was already used. | `Error`, error `invalid_client` |
| `404` | Does not exist, expired, or belongs to someone else. The three look the same so ids cannot be probed. | `Error`, error `not_found` |
| `422` | The manifest failed validation. Nothing changed. | `Error`, error `invalid_manifest` |
| `503` | A store failed or the replay cache is full. Nothing changed. Retry with a new idempotency key. | `Error`, error `temporarily_unavailable` |

## Kill switches

Turn a tool, a player or the whole game off and on during an incident. Signed with the admin key.

### `GET /v1/studio/switches`

**List the switches that are on.** Signed with the admin key. Not mounted unless an admin key is configured.

Auth: `adminSignature`.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | The switches that are on, ordered by tenant, tool, player. | object |
| `401` | The signature is missing, wrong, stale, or the signed request was already used. | `Error`, error `invalid_client` |
| `503` | A store failed or the replay cache is full. Nothing changed. Retry with a new idempotency key. | `Error`, error `temporarily_unavailable` |

Example response:

```json
{
  "switches": [
    {
      "tenant": "tinycity",
      "tool": "build_structure"
    }
  ]
}
```

### `PUT /v1/studio/switches`

**Turn a switch on.** Blocks every tier the switch matches, reads included, from the next call on. Turning on a switch that is already on is not an error. With no `tool` and no `player` the whole game is switched off. The tenant is always the gateway's own. `X-AG-Player` names the acting admin and is recorded in an audit event (tool `admin.switch.on`). The reason is logged, not stored in the audit event.

Auth: `adminSignature`.

Request body (`application/json`): What to switch. An empty body switches the whole game. At most 4 KiB.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tool` | string | no | A tool name. Omit for every tool. |
| `player` | string | no | Printable ASCII, no spaces. Omit for every player. |
| `reason` | string | no | Free text for the logs. Not stored in the audit event. |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | The switch and its new state. | `SwitchResult` |
| `400` | A query parameter is malformed. | `Error`, error `invalid_request` |
| `401` | The signature is missing, wrong, stale, or the signed request was already used. | `Error`, error `invalid_client` |
| `413` | The body is over the endpoint's limit. | `Error`, error `too_large` |
| `503` | A store failed or the replay cache is full. Nothing changed. Retry with a new idempotency key. | `Error`, error `temporarily_unavailable` |

Example response:

```json
{
  "switch": {
    "tenant": "tinycity",
    "tool": "build_structure"
  },
  "on": true
}
```

### `DELETE /v1/studio/switches`

**Turn a switch off.** Same body as turning one on. Turning off a switch that is not on is not an error. Recorded in an audit event (tool `admin.switch.off`).

Auth: `adminSignature`.

Request body (`application/json`): What to switch back on. An empty body clears the whole-game switch.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tool` | string | no | A tool name. Omit for every tool. |
| `player` | string | no | Printable ASCII, no spaces. Omit for every player. |
| `reason` | string | no | Free text for the logs. Not stored in the audit event. |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | The switch and its new state. | `SwitchResult` |
| `400` | A query parameter is malformed. | `Error`, error `invalid_request` |
| `401` | The signature is missing, wrong, stale, or the signed request was already used. | `Error`, error `invalid_client` |
| `413` | The body is over the endpoint's limit. | `Error`, error `too_large` |
| `503` | A store failed or the replay cache is full. Nothing changed. Retry with a new idempotency key. | `Error`, error `temporarily_unavailable` |

Example response:

```json
{
  "switch": {
    "tenant": "tinycity",
    "tool": "build_structure"
  },
  "on": false
}
```

## Activity

What a player's agents did, read from the audit log.

### `GET /v1/studio/activity`

**The player feed.** What the signed player's agents did, newest first. Sign it with the studio key. A `player` or `tenant` query parameter is ignored, so a player can only read their own events. When more remain, `next_before` is the value to pass as `before` for the next page.

Auth: `studioSignature`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tool` | query | string | no | Only events of this tool. |
| `outcome` | query | string: `ok`, `denied`, `error` | no | Only events with this outcome. |
| `since` | query | string (date-time) | no | Only events at or after this time (RFC 3339). |
| `limit` | query | integer | no | Page size. Default 50, at most 200, larger values are clamped. |
| `before` | query | integer (int64) | no | A cursor: only events with a smaller id. Use `next_before` from the previous page. |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | A page of events. | `Feed` |
| `400` | A query parameter is malformed. | `Error`, error `invalid_request` |
| `401` | The signature is missing, wrong, stale, or the signed request was already used. | `Error`, error `invalid_client` |
| `503` | A store failed or the replay cache is full. Nothing changed. Retry with a new idempotency key. | `Error`, error `temporarily_unavailable` |

Example response:

```json
{
  "events": [
    {
      "id": 42,
      "time": "2026-03-01T10:05:00Z",
      "tool": "sell_resource",
      "tier": "medium",
      "outcome": "denied",
      "code": "daily_amount_cap",
      "args_sha256": "9f2c00"
    }
  ],
  "next_before": 41
}
```

### `GET /v1/studio/admin/activity`

**The admin feed.** Events of any player of the gateway's tenant. Sign it with the admin key. `X-AG-Player` is the acting admin and is not a filter, use the `player` query parameter for that. Rows name the player.

Auth: `adminSignature`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `player` | query | string | no | Only this player's events. |
| `tool` | query | string | no | Only events of this tool. |
| `outcome` | query | string: `ok`, `denied`, `error` | no | Only events with this outcome. |
| `since` | query | string (date-time) | no | Only events at or after this time (RFC 3339). |
| `limit` | query | integer | no | Page size. Default 50, at most 200, larger values are clamped. |
| `before` | query | integer (int64) | no | A cursor: only events with a smaller id. Use `next_before` from the previous page. |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | A page of events. | `Feed` |
| `400` | A query parameter is malformed. | `Error`, error `invalid_request` |
| `401` | The signature is missing, wrong, stale, or the signed request was already used. | `Error`, error `invalid_client` |
| `503` | A store failed or the replay cache is full. Nothing changed. Retry with a new idempotency key. | `Error`, error `temporarily_unavailable` |

## Relay

Connect a game client that holds its own game state.

### `POST /v1/studio/relay/tickets`

**Mint a relay ticket for a player's game client.** The studio backend hands the ticket to the game client, which opens the WebSocket with it. The signed `X-AG-Player` is the player. The ticket is signed with the relay secret and valid for `--relay-ticket-ttl` (60 seconds by default). It can be reused until it expires, and a newer socket for the same player replaces the older one. Not mounted unless `AGENTGW_RELAY_SECRET` is set.

Auth: `studioSignature`.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | The ticket. | `RelayTicket` |
| `401` | The signature is missing, wrong, stale, or the signed request was already used. | `Error`, error `invalid_client` |
| `413` | The body is over the endpoint's limit. | `Error`, error `too_large` |
| `503` | A store failed or the replay cache is full. Nothing changed. Retry with a new idempotency key. | `Error`, error `temporarily_unavailable` |

Example response:

```json
{
  "ticket": "eyJ0Ijoi",
  "expires_at": "2026-01-02T03:05:05Z"
}
```

### `GET /v1/relay/connect`

**Open the game client's WebSocket.** A WebSocket upgrade. The ticket is checked before the upgrade. One socket per player: a new connection closes the old one with close code 4000. After the upgrade the gateway sends `{"type":"hello","protocol":1}` and then `call` frames. The client answers each with a `result` frame, see the relay section of docs/PROTOCOL.md.

Auth: `relayTicket`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ticket` | query | string | no | The ticket, for clients that cannot set a header. The header wins when both are given. |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `101` | Switching protocols. The socket is open. |  |
| `401` | The ticket is missing, tampered with or expired. | `Error`, error `invalid_ticket` |

## OAuth

The embedded OAuth 2.1 authorization server that agents use to link. Agents and MCP clients call these, not the studio.

### `GET /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server`

**Authorization server metadata (RFC 8414).** An MCP client finds the rest from here. The protected resource metadata at `/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp` is served next to the MCP endpoint.

Auth: none.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | The metadata. | object |

### `POST /register`

**Dynamic client registration (RFC 7591).** Registers a public client. Rate limited per client address (`--register-per-hour`), and the number of clients is capped (`--max-clients`).

Auth: none.

Request body (`application/json`): 

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `client_name` | string | yes |  |
| `redirect_uris` | array of string | yes |  |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | The registered client. | object |
| `400` | invalid_client_metadata or invalid_redirect_uri. | `Error` |
| `429` | Too many registrations from this address. Retry-After says when. | `Error` |
| `503` | A store failed or the replay cache is full. Nothing changed. Retry with a new idempotency key. | `Error`, error `temporarily_unavailable` |

### `GET /authorize`

**The consent page.** Shows the consent page where the player enters the link code and picks coach or operator. Needs PKCE S256 and `response_type=code`. Errors are shown on the page or redirected to a verified redirect URI.

Auth: none.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `response_type` | query | string | yes | Must be `code`. |
| `client_id` | query | string | yes |  |
| `redirect_uri` | query | string | yes |  |
| `code_challenge` | query | string | yes | The S256 challenge. |
| `code_challenge_method` | query | string | yes | Must be `S256`. |
| `state` | query | string | no |  |
| `scope` | query | string | no | Space separated, `coach` or `operator`. |
| `resource` | query | string | no | The MCP resource URL the token is bound to. |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | The consent page (HTML). |  |
| `400` | The request is invalid (HTML or a redirect with an error). |  |

### `POST /authorize`

**Submit the consent page.** The player allows or denies, with a link code. Wrong, used and expired codes look the same. Every submission counts against a per-address limit.

Auth: none.

Request body (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`): 

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `decision` | string | yes | `allow` to grant, anything else denies. |
| `scope_choice` | string | no | `coach` or `operator`. |
| `ticket` | string | no | The link code from the game. |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `302` | Redirect to the client's redirect URI with a code (or an error). |  |
| `401` | The link code did not work (HTML). |  |
| `429` | Too many attempts (HTML). Retry-After says when. |  |

### `POST /token`

**Exchange a code or refresh a token.** `authorization_code` exchanges the code with the PKCE verifier. `refresh_token` rotates the refresh token. Reusing a rotated refresh token revokes the grant. Access tokens are opaque.

Auth: none.

Request body (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`): 

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `grant_type` | string | yes | `authorization_code` or `refresh_token`. |
| `client_id` | string | yes |  |
| `code` | string | no |  |
| `redirect_uri` | string | no |  |
| `code_verifier` | string | no |  |
| `resource` | string | no |  |
| `refresh_token` | string | no |  |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | The tokens. | `Token` |
| `400` | invalid_request, invalid_grant or unsupported_grant_type. | `Error` |
| `503` | A store failed or the replay cache is full. Nothing changed. Retry with a new idempotency key. | `Error`, error `temporarily_unavailable` |

| `tool` | string | no | A tool name. Omit for every tool. |
| `player` | string | no | Printable ASCII, no spaces. Omit for every player. |
| `reason` | string | no | Free text for the logs. Not stored in the audit event. |

### SwitchResult

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |

| `on` | boolean | yes |  |
